identity_review.polar_scope: For a symmetric idempotent binary projector, the Z4 quadratic polar of wt(Px) is P. Phase subtraction adds polars over F2. Nested-rank dimension differences do not require an orthonormal basis for the residual complement, which may be alternating.
identity_review.signed_C_scope: For orthonormal frame vectors, the Hamming weight of their XOR is the sum of individual weights modulo4, since pairwise intersections are even. This gives the signed-C factorization and fixes character-zero phase. It is not an independent native compiler execution.
